title: count_vowels misses uppercase
description: count_vowels only counts lowercase vowels, missing uppercase ones. Normalize case before counting.

hidden_tests.test_text.py:
from text import count_vowels


def test_count_vowels():
    assert count_vowels('hello') == 2
    assert count_vowels('AEIOU') == 5
    assert count_vowels('Programming') == 3
    assert count_vowels('') == 0
